result.reason: The redline adds the requested professional-and-workmanlike standard, software and service conformance warranties, stated durations, remedies, and malicious-code protection. However, the software warranty runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery, acceptance, or performance, so it may provide materially less than 12 months of post-delivery coverage. It also limits the compliance-with-laws warranty to compliance 'in all material respects,' which does not fully reach the unqualified playbook position. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but these limitations prevent full compliance.
